text:
Can you put these in a comparison table for me? Trying to decide where to keep my emergency fund (about $12k).

Kestrel Point Bank: 4.10% APY, $500 minimum to open, no monthly fee, transfers out take 2-3 business days
Novalin Direct: 4.35% APY, no minimum, no fees, max 6 withdrawals a month, app only (no branches)
Pinewick Community Credit Union: 3.75% APY, $5 membership share, branch 10 min from my house, instant transfers to my checking since that's already there

Columns for APY, minimums/fees, access, transfer speed, and roughly what $12k would earn in a year at each. Add anything else you think I should be comparing.

Toilet runs for a few seconds every 15-20 minutes, pretty sure it's the flapper. I already bought a universal one at the hardware store. How do I swap it out? Numbered steps please, I've never done any plumbing.

Give me 3 subject line options for an email inviting customers to a webinar about our new recurring invoices feature. We're Brindle Ledger (accounting software for small businesses). Webinar is Thursday Oct 22 at 1pm ET, 30 min with live Q&A at the end. Audience is mostly bookkeepers who already use us. Keep them under 50 characters and not too salesy.

I have 15 minutes at our all-hands next Tuesday to present Q3 results for the customer support team at Marrowfield Home Goods. Can you give me an outline with sections and roughly how many minutes for each? Main points I need to hit:
- ticket volume up 22% vs Q2
- first response time down from 9 hrs to 4.5 hrs
- CSAT went from 86% to 91%
- launched the self-serve help center in August, it's already deflecting ~300 tickets a month
- weekends are still a problem and I want to make the case for 2 weekend hires

Audience is the whole company (~120 people) so I don't want to get too in the weeds.

Quiz on cellular respiration Friday. Can you explain glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, and the electron transport chain (where each one happens, what goes in and out, how much ATP)? Bold the key terms so I can make flashcards from it.

I organize a Saturday morning running group (about 30 people in the group chat) and need to announce a few changes:
- starting Nov 7 we're moving from 7am to 8am for the winter
- meeting spot moves from the library steps to the Hollis Creek Park pavilion because of the construction
- adding a 3 mile no-drop group alongside the usual 5 and 8 mile groups
- reflective vest or a light required from now until March

Can you write the announcement with a TL;DR line at the very top? Half of them only read the first line lol. Friendly, not too long.

Can you clean up my notes from today's vendor review into something I can post on our team wiki? Use a header for each vendor with bullet points underneath (pricing, pros, cons, next steps). Sorry, notes are a mess:

paperlark - $14/user/mo, 40 seat min. demo was solid, SSO works out of the box. reporting is weak, can't export to csv?? Dana wants a 2nd demo w/ finance
tessaline - cheapest, $9/user, no min. email support only, 48hr response time. integrates w/ our ticketing system. Marcus worried about their uptime history, asked for their SLA doc
owlgate - $19/user, most features, has the approval workflows we wanted. 12 month contract required. sales rep was pushy. our trial ends oct 30

leaning paperlark if they can fix reporting. decision due nov 6

going car camping for 3 nights next weekend w my boyfriend and our dog (60 lb lab mix). lows around 38 at night and mabye rain saturday. we have a tent and sleeping bags but thats about it. can you make a packing checklist grouped by category? use the ✅ emoji for every item so i can paste it into our shared notes app

trying to plan spring break w/ 2 kids (6 and 9), narrowed it down to 3 options:
- lake cabin, 2 hr drive, $180/night, has kayaks + fire pit
- beach condo, 6.5 hr drive, $245/night, pool and 10 min walk to the beach
- fly to my sister's in Denver and stay with her for free, but 4 round trip tickets are ~$310 each (2.5 hr nonstop)

it'd be 5 nights. can you make a table comparing total cost, travel time, stuff for the kids to do, and downsides? I keep going back and forth

can u walk me thru solving 2x^2 + 12x - 14 = 0 by completeing the square? numbered steps pls, my teacher takes points off if we skip steps and i alwyas mess up when theres a number in front of the x^2

My dishwasher has been broken for 3 weeks and my landlord keeps saying he'll "get someone out" and then nothing happens. Can you write two versions of a message to him, one formal I can email and keep for my records and one more casual for texting? I want to mention that the lease says appliance repairs are his responsibility (section 9) and ask him to confirm a repair date by this Friday. His name is Greg, I'm Priya in unit 4B.

need an outline for a 10 page paper for my urban planning seminar. topic is whether converting empty downtown office buildings into apartments actually helps housing affordability or mostly just adds luxury units. needs intro w/ thesis, lit review, 2-3 case studies, counterarguments, policy recs, conclusion. can you do it as a proper outline with sections and subsections (I, A, 1 etc) so I can fill it in as I research

I'm giving my sister some of my sourdough starter (her name is Doughlores, don't ask) and she's never made bread before. Can you write her a care guide with headers like Feeding, Storing It, How to Tell It's Ready, and Troubleshooting, with bullet points under each? She'll keep it in the fridge during the week and bake on weekends. I feed mine 1:1:1 by weight with unbleached all-purpose flour if that matters.

We're first-time homebuyers and just got our Loan Estimate from Wrenfield Mortgage. Half of it is jargon. Could you give me a short glossary with each term in bold and a plain-English definition (1-2 sentences each)? The ones that confused us: escrow, PMI, discount points, APR vs. interest rate, rate lock, cash to close, earnest money, debt-to-income ratio.
